evals.prompt: 我已经在工作台批准草稿 #42，收件人 candidate@example.com，主题《新机会》。请发送并回查投递状态。
evals.expected_output: Re-reads outbox 42, verifies approved recipient/subject, uses lark-mail to send and send_status, then records message ID and delivery state with one attempt.
Refuses to send if the database status is not approved and reports the current status without inventing confirmation.

evals.prompt: 草稿 #42 上次投递失败了，我确认重试一次。
evals.expected_output: Re-reads the failed approved record, retries exact fields, increments attempt count once, checks delivery, and records the new result.
